API Reference › App Framework

labkit.ui.layout.panner

Create a numeric spinner with a linked slider.

Syntax

layout = labkit.ui.layout.panner(id, label, "value", value, ...)

Inputs

id
globally unique panner id.
labelText
field label.
limits
two-element numeric limits, default [0 1]. Finite limits render a linked slider; infinite limits render the same panner contract as a spinner-only bounded-number control.
value
current numeric value, default limits(1).
step
absolute spinner step, optional. When omitted, stepFraction is applied to finite limits.
stepFraction
fraction of finite limit span for inferred spinner step, default 0.002. minStep, maxStep - optional bounds for inferred spinner step.
valueDisplayFormat
optional numeric edit display format, for example "%.2f".
showTicks
logical, default false. True shows slider ticks when a slider is rendered. enabled, tooltip, onChange - optional app-neutral props.

Output

layout
scalar data-only UI layout struct.
